goal: Let wallet frontends learn whether a transaction was accepted into the mempool.
Stops interfaces like the QML GUI from reporting transactions as sent when rejected by the node.
agreement: Concept approval without stated reasons (w0xlt, Naomi-Gift)
Author clarified why synchronous broadcast errors are needed rather than async alerts (maflcko)
Open request to add interface test coverage for mempool rejections (ViniciusCestarii)

categories.name: ipc
why: P3 because it passes structured broadcast errors across process boundaries to frontends like the QML GUI.
Unblocks out-of-process frontends from detecting and handling rejected transactions.

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it fixes a flaw where broadcast errors were discarded and only logged internally.
Prevents callers from falsely reporting success when the node rejects a transaction.
